ManifestSource.description: One source as recorded in the manifest.

archived.description: Whether the repository is archived upstream; `null` when unknown.

commit.description: The commit the ref resolved to.

ref.description: The configured ref (branch, tag or SHA).

render.description:
The render step (SPEC §10.1) that ran over this source's selected pages, absent when
none did. External command paths are recorded as they were actually run (absolutised
against the config file at resolve time), so `resolve --from-manifest` can re-run the
exact program regardless of where the manifest is reproduced from (SPEC §2.2).

residue.description: Relative paths of pages left out (see `residue.jsonl` for why).

unrendered.description: Selected paths a render step (SPEC §10.1) produced no page for.

unresolved.description: Navigation links the resolver reported that have no file.

doc_type.description: Document type as reported by the resolver; may be empty.

rendered_from.description:
The selected path this page was rendered from (SPEC §10.1), when it is a rendered page
rather than a copy of the selected file.

section.description: Navigation section as reported by the resolver; may be empty.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file bytes.

title.description: Page title (nav title, first H1 or frontmatter `title:`; may be empty).

Render.description:
How a source's selected pages become Markdown pages, when they are not already Markdown
(SPEC §10.1). The render step runs after selection and before the artifact is written.

oneOf.description: Run an external command that emits the SPEC §10.1 JSONL contract.

command.description: Program and leading arguments; relative paths are resolved against the config file.

SelectedBy.description: What caused a page to be selected.

description: The curated references for every source.

artifact_version.description:
The artifact contract version (SPEC §2.8) the manifest and its artifact follow; missing
means 1. Written as [`ARTIFACT_VERSION`]; a higher value is rejected on read.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the manifest was generated.

title: Manifest
